name: boostune
description: Boost, balance, and control audio for individual browser tabs. Volume from 0% to 600% with per-tab control.

scripts.build: npm run build:chromium && npm run build:firefox
scripts.package:chromium: npm run build:chromium && cd dist && tar.exe -a -c -f boostune-chromium-v1.0.0.zip chromium/*
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist && tar.exe -a -c -f boostune-firefox-v1.0.0.zip firefox/*
